Pleasant Hill, Oregon · Family & Veteran-Owned Since 1981

Feed, farm supply, and real help loading it into your truck.

Pleasant Hill Feed & Farm Supply has been the local stop for animal feed and farm essentials for over 40 years. Owner Travis and the crew price-match the big box stores, special-order what they don't stock, and load the heavy bags for you — which is why people drive out from Eugene just to shop here.

What We Carry

Everything the animals and the land need, in one barn.

From daily feed runs to the odd part you can't find anywhere else, we keep the shelves stocked and the prices fair.
